explanation: Insulin was first used to treat a person with diabetes in Toronto in 1922. Frederick Banting and John Macleod shared the 1923 Nobel Prize for its discovery.

claims.text: Insulin is made by the pancreas, in the beta cells of its islets.
The liver, spleen and gallbladder do not make insulin.
Insulin was first used to treat a person with diabetes in Toronto in 1922.
Frederick Banting and John Macleod shared the 1923 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for the discovery of insulin.
